notes: A218483.rep_iff: for odd P and prime p | P, (exists n : Z, P = 8pn + p^2) <-> P % 8 = 1; odd_of_psp; conj1, conj3 (all prime factors alike for base-2 psps), conj2 (P = p1 p2 = 8 p1 n + p1^2 -> P = 8 p2 (-n) + p2^2), not_15_mod_40 (no base-2 psp is 15 mod 40).
